title: Standards concern file (docs/conventions/standards.yaml)
description: Consumer-side single source of truth for the standards convention. Every key is optional; absent keys mean the documented defaults.

standards_dir.description: Team standards root, relative to the resolution root (git top-level). Holds the standards index (README.md with standards-contract frontmatter), SRP-organized standards files, and gitignored *.local.md personal overrides.

guidance_dir.description: Folder holding the guidance index (README.md with standards-contract frontmatter), relative to the resolution root. No default: absent means the repository publishes no guidance index.

standards_repositories.description: Team or repository list of standards sources, honored only when this repository's owner is in the person's trusted_owners. The repository list is read from the default branch, never the working tree.

ref.description: Full commit SHA to pin; required when the source's owner is not in trusted_owners.

surfaces.description: Surface ids to keep, in both of the source's indexes (standards and guidance); absent, every row.

only_in.description: Globs over <owner>/<repo>; the entry applies only where one matches the current repository.

except_in.description: Globs over <owner>/<repo>; the entry is skipped where one matches the current repository.
